planning_pages.title: Biostatistics, Power & Experimental Design Studio
planning_pages.description: Estimate sample size, power, dropout impact and design sensitivity using transparent assumptions.

planning_pages.title: Study Protocol Designer
planning_pages.description: Build a complete, reviewable research protocol from objectives through visits, endpoints, deviations and amendments.

planning_pages.title: Sample Size & Statistical Power Studio
planning_pages.description: Calculate transparent sample-size scenarios across continuous, binary, survival, repeated-measures and clustered designs.

planning_pages.title: Clinical Trial Design Studio
planning_pages.description: Design phase-aware clinical trials with arms, cohorts, interim decisions, endpoints, recruitment and safety monitoring.

planning_pages.title: Experimental Design & DoE Workbench
planning_pages.description: Create and analyse factorial, response-surface, screening and optimal experimental designs for laboratory and process studies.

planning_pages.title: Randomization, Blinding & Allocation Studio
planning_pages.description: Generate reproducible allocation schedules with strata, variable blocks, concealment and balance diagnostics.

planning_pages.title: Cohort Definition & Eligibility Builder
planning_pages.description: Define reproducible eligibility rules, estimate feasible cohorts and explain every inclusion or exclusion decision.

planning_pages.title: Endpoint & Outcome Strategy Studio
planning_pages.description: Prioritise primary, secondary and exploratory endpoints with burden, validity, missingness and multiplicity controls.

planning_pages.title: Biomarker Study Planning Studio
planning_pages.description: Plan diagnostic, prognostic and predictive biomarker studies from discovery through independent validation.

planning_pages.title: Sampling & Biospecimen Planning Studio
planning_pages.description: Plan collection, aliquoting, storage, shipping and retention for biospecimen-intensive studies.

planning_pages.title: Data Collection & CRF Designer
planning_pages.description: Design structured case-report forms, data dictionaries and validation rules across visits and study domains.

planning_pages.title: Statistical Analysis Plan Studio
planning_pages.description: Build a versioned statistical analysis plan linking populations, endpoints, models, covariates, multiplicity and sensitivity analyses.

planning_pages.title: Research Feasibility & Recruitment Planner
planning_pages.description: Forecast enrolment, screen failures, site activation, dropout, cost and study-completion probability.

planning_pages.title: Research Timeline, Milestones & Dependencies Studio
planning_pages.description: Plan tasks, dependencies, critical paths, resources and risk-adjusted timelines across a research programme.

planning_pages.title: Research Risk & Mitigation Planner
planning_pages.description: Identify, score, mitigate and monitor scientific, statistical, assay, data and operational research risks.

planning_pages.title: Evidence Gap & Literature Planning Studio
planning_pages.description: Map existing evidence, contradictions and unanswered questions to justify and prioritise new research.

planning_pages.title: Pre-Registration & Reproducibility Studio
planning_pages.description: Lock hypotheses, outcomes, exclusions, sample-size rationale and analysis decisions before observing study outcomes.

planning_pages.title: Research Planning Command Center
planning_pages.description: Connect protocol, endpoints, sample size, CRFs, SAP, recruitment, risks, budgets and preregistration in one traceable planning system.

planning_pages.title: Research Budget & Participant Burden Studio
planning_pages.description: Model participant burden, site capacity and probabilistic study costs with transparent assumptions.

planning_pages.title: Synthetic Cohort & Trial Simulation Lab
planning_pages.description: Simulate cohorts, treatment arms, outcomes, event times and site heterogeneity for design stress-testing.

standards_requirements.requirement: Protocol identifier and version are defined
Scientific background and rationale are documented
Primary and secondary objectives are explicit
Study design, allocation and blinding are specified
Eligibility criteria and recruitment setting are specified
Interventions, comparators and adherence are described
Primary and secondary outcomes include timing and measurement method
Sample-size rationale is linked to assumptions
Data collection, management and monitoring plans are defined
Consent, ethics and dissemination plans are recorded
Critical-to-quality factors are identified
Risk controls are proportionate and assigned
Participant safety, burden and rights are assessed
Source, traceability and data-quality controls are specified
Treatment condition of interest is defined
Estimand population is defined
Outcome variable is defined
Intercurrent events and strategies are prespecified
Population-level summary and estimator are specified
Sensitivity analyses address key assumptions
Objectives, endpoints, activities and epochs are machine-readable
CRF variables use controlled names, types and units
Collected variables have target domains and identifiers
Analysis variables have derivation, source and analysis role
Source resources and CRF destinations are linked
